This grocery row has no printed taxable marker; its zero-tax treatment is corroborated by the receipt arithmetic. The printed GST taxable-value is 8.00, exactly the chocolate net after its card saving; the burrito net is 16.00 and bears no G code.
G is printed beside SWISS 72% DARK CHOC, with printed GST taxable-value 8.00 and GST amount 0.40 after its card saving.
